a.lede: Nvidia reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday amid the dramatic exit of ex-CEO Jensen Huang.
a.title: Nvidia reports bumper results as firm says it's not reinstating Huang

b.lede: Nvidia interim CEO and longtime CFO Colette Kress is about to have one of the biggest days of her career on Tuesday when the company reports its third-quarter results. Given the turmoil Nvidia is in, there are a number of questions that Nvidia should answer.
b.title: All the questions Nvidia should answer on Tuesday — but probably won’t
